old Japanese way of calling this race. Dobrotvorsky also notes that the word Aino is a corruption of Ainu which he defines as " man." With regard to this

hi or

/

or

score," is the highest unit ever present to the Ainu mind when counting. Thus, forty is "two " " three score " score (tu hot ne) ; sixty is (re hot ne) ; eighty " four score " " " is hot ne) ; and a hundred is five score (ine
